title: Spanish Paella with Asparagus
description: A classic Spanish dish made with saffron-infused rice, vegetables, and seafood, perfect for a quick and flavorful meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the asparagus and cook for 2-3 minutes, until slightly tender.
Add the Spanish rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Remove the cover and cook for an additional 5-10 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
